summary: Four-legged steel tower about 120 ft tall on Holt Bald in Ozark County, built in fiscal 1951-52; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Four-legged steel structure carrying an observation cabin

events.note: A 40-acre towersite was acquired in fiscal 1950-51, as the lookout page reports from the commission's annual reports.
A new tower was erected at the Lutie towersite in fiscal 1951-52. The fiscal year spans two calendar years, so the build year is approximate.
The Coast and Geodetic Survey described the station.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources were read: the lookout page (which transcribes the commission's annual reports) and the NGS datasheet. Web search was unavailable because the run's search budget was used up, so no news, agency or heritage sources were checked. Fiscal years straddle calendar years, so the 1951 build year is approximate. No source read describes the site or tower today, so status, access and visit facts are omitted. The brief's 36.6 m height matches the NGS 120-foot figure and the record is not corrected.
